title: Initial condition recovery in nonlinear damped viscous photoacoustic tomography using a convolutional neural network-guided gradient-free optimization framework
abstract: arXiv:2610.01015v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Photoacoustic tomography (PAT) is a hybrid imaging modality that combines high optical contrast with high ultrasonic resolution for biomedical imaging applications. In this work, we investigate the inverse problem of recovering the initial pressure distribution from boundary measurements in the presence of nonlinear acoustic propagation and viscous attenuation effects. To model these phenomena more accurately, we consider a nonlinear damped viscoelastic wave equation incorporating spatially varying sound speed, temporal attenuation, and nonlinear propagation mechanisms. We first establish the well-posedness of the corresponding forward problem using a Galerkin approximation combined with energy estimates and a fixed-point argument. translated_title: 使用卷积神经网络引导的无梯度优化框架在非线性阻尼粘性光声断层成像中恢复初始条件
translated_abstract: 光声断层成像（PAT）是一种混合成像模式，它将高光学对比度与高超声分辨率相结合，应用于生物医学成像。在本工作中，我们研究了在非线性声传播和粘性衰减效应存在的情况下，从边界测量数据中恢复初始压力分布的反问题。为了更准确地建模这些现象，我们考虑了一个包含空间变化声速、时间衰减和非线性传播机制的非线性阻尼粘弹性波动方程。我们首先使用Galerkin近似结合能量估计和不动点论证，建立了相应正问题的适定性。对于反问题，我们通过调和延拓约化、谱拉普拉斯变换技术和能观性方法，在适当假设下推导出了存在性、唯一性和局部唯一性结果。
tldr: 本文提出了一种卷积神经网络引导的无梯度优化框架，用于从边界测量数据中恢复非线性阻尼粘性光声断层成像中的初始压力分布，并建立了相应正问题的适定性和反问题的存在性与唯一性理论。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a convolutional neural network-guided gradient-free optimization framework for recovering the initial pressure distribution from boundary measurements in nonlinear damped viscous photoacoustic tomography, while establishing well-posedness of the forward problem and existence and uniqueness results for the inverse problem.
